ci_seen.note: FF-RC6 known sibling-gotcha: known_tenant_tables.txt changed on branch triggers role-criticality check; green post-merge to dev by design. All other fitness checks pass (127 PASS). npm test: 1072 passed. tsc: clean.

findings.issue: AC-6 tests SELECT=0 without GUC (USING clause of RLS policy) but does not attempt an INSERT with wrong-tenant GUC to verify WITH CHECK clause. Both USING and WITH CHECK are created in the same CREATE POLICY statement, so the risk is zero — but full AC-6 coverage would include an INSERT-rejected probe.
findings.suggestion: Add an INSERT probe under appUrl() with tenant_id set to TENANT_A while GUC is set to TENANT_B (or omitted), asserting it raises a policy violation. Covers WITH CHECK side of the default-DENY policy.

findings.issue: Cross-tenant negative probe for the `notification` table itself is absent due to the FK constraint on employee (inserting a direct row requires a valid employee row). The test correctly uses notification_preference as a proxy and explains this in a comment. The RLS mechanism is identical for all three tables.
findings.suggestion: No immediate action required — proxy approach is valid and documented. If a future test fixture seeds an employee row, add a direct notification cross-tenant probe for completeness.
